app.tagline: Everything you watch. One single log.

welcome.title: Your <0>log</0> is empty.
welcome.body: Every title you add writes a dated line. Every time you rewatch something, that's another viewing, with its own date and its own rating. After a while you're no longer looking at a list: you're rereading your history.
welcome.legal: stays on this device · no account · exportable data

home.watchingWhat: What you're currently watching, with its progress and the button to move it forward.

library.title: Library
library.what: Everything you've logged, filterable by status and by favourite.

log.title: Log
log.what: The timestamped feed of everything you've done. The tail -f of your viewing life.

stats.title: Stats
stats.what: Total time, breakdown, ratings, genres. All computed from your viewings.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.what: This address doesn't match any screen.

debug.title: /debug
debug.note: media_state is derived: rebuilding it loses no data. events is the source of truth and is never modified.
debug.backupNote: the .log carries everything needed to rebuild the journal, titles included. Importing it twice is a no-op.

attribution.tmdb: Movie and TV data provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

search.emptyHint: Check the spelling, or try the original title.
search.unavailableHint: The service is not responding. Titles you already added stay available.
search.offlineHint: Set the title aside: you'll confirm it when the network is back.
search.confirmPending: Confirm the titles you set aside
